summary: Keep committed indexer RPC reads available during SQLite block writes
details: Use WAL with FULL synchronous commits and bounded connection lock waits so block writes do not exclude the independent committed-state reader.
Preserve atomic height and anchor publication, rollback, crash recovery, and existing database contents when adopting WAL.
Consolidate WAL only in the frozen checkpoint staging copy before hashing and signing its files, preserving committed data and stable verification inventories.
Run deterministic spilled-write, legacy database, atomic snapshot, and checkpoint WAL regressions in the weekly indexer protocol suite.
operator_actions: Ship the updated indexer and checkpoint tool together and restart the indexer. Existing data is retained; no network reset or database rebuild is required.
